title: 第十七章 奇怪的天道誓言第十八章 我说不是我干的你信不
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: 周自珩见这两个口口声声叫那小野种为小公主的，竟都是炼气九层的修士也不惧。
他就不信，在这灵植宗收徒的档口，这两人敢和自己动手。
他找自己的女儿再正常不过。
谁都不能阻拦父母认自己的孩子、带自己孩子回家的吧！
旁边陪着孩子、或是自己来报名围观排队之人，听他们说的话看看玄稷，又看向那周自珩一家，不知道谁说的是真，谁说的是假。
周自珩突然发现玄稷手上拿着的一个小儿拳头大的青色果子，他没看出来那是什么果子。
但那果子上灵气四溢，立马就严肃脸。
“你们诓骗我女儿，把家里的灵果都偷了出来，还不让她跟我回家去，到底是何用心？
大家伙来评评理！”
周自珩说着像是受了莫大的委屈看向四周，希望有人能出来说句公道话。
“哪有人阻拦不让父母接孩子回家的？
分明是诓骗我家孩子偷拿家里的灵植灵果，还诓骗孩子是被我们扔出去的，真是用心险恶啊！”
宋文妤抱着满脸委屈的周欣甜也哭诉。
“就是啊，那孩子要真是被我们献给邪修了，她还能好好活着站在这里吃灵果吗？”
她这话一说，不明所以的人，也都纷纷点头。
“是啊，现在邪修多猖狂啊，别说这么白嫩的小娃了，就是老头老太他们也不会放过早就吸干了，就是皮还要拿去做灯笼呢！”
“确实，看那小娃确实被人给欺骗了。”
有个老妇看不过去劝起玄稷。
“小娃娃莫要听信外人谗言，赶快跟你爹娘回家去吧。
往后也再不能偷拿家里的东西，这是吃里扒外呀，你爹娘养你一场不容易！”
说着还鄙夷地看着荷花莲花，心想这两人长得人模人样，却尽不干人事。
越来越多人偏向周自珩一家，都在劝玄稷回家去听话些，不能偷拿家里东西。
可把莲花荷花气得不行，却不知怎么反驳。
她们又被尊上告诫过，不可以在外随意伤人暴露身份，很是憋屈。
桃花和荷花在魔界也从来没见过这么不要脸的人。
也没有办法证明她们说的是正确的，因为那些人根本就不信，只信他们自己信的。
玄稷这时开口了。
“你说我偷拿了你的灵植，那拿的是什么？
总不能你家里少了什么东西却不知道吧？”
玄稷脑子可没有之前那么好骗了，一眼就看出来，这一家人不过是看中自己手中的灵植。
上次在那成衣铺子里，这不要脸的周自珩就因为那狗尾巴草，否认把自己丢给邪修的事。
现在又来这招？
content_en:
Zhou Ziheng was not afraid when he saw that these two people who kept calling the little bastard the little princess were actually monks at the ninth level of Qi Refining.
He didn't believe that these two people dared to fight him at the stall where Lingzhi Sect was recruiting disciples.
It's normal for him to look for his daughter.
No one can stop parents from recognizing their children and taking their children home!
Those who accompanied their children or signed up by themselves watched the people queuing up, listened to what they said, looked at Xuan Ji, and then looked at Zhou Ziheng's family, not knowing who was telling the truth and who was lying.
Zhou Ziheng suddenly noticed a green fruit as big as a child's fist that Xuan Ji was holding in his hand. He didn't know what kind of fruit it was.
But the fruit was full of spiritual energy, and his face immediately became serious.
"You deceived my daughter, stole all the spiritual fruits at home, and refused to let her go home with me. What are your intentions?
Come and comment, everyone! "
Zhou Ziheng said as if he had been greatly wronged and looked around, hoping that someone would come out and say something fair.
“Who would stop parents from taking their children home?
He was clearly tricking my child into stealing the spiritual plant and spiritual fruit at home, and also tricking the child into thinking that he was thrown out by us. What a sinister intention! "
Song Wenyu hugged Zhou Xintian who looked aggrieved and cried.
"That's right. If that child is really sacrificed to evil cultivators by us, can she still stand here alive and eat the spiritual fruit?"
As soon as she said this, people who didn't know why also nodded.
"Yes, evil cultivators are so rampant now. Not to mention such a fair and tender baby, even old men and ladies would not let it go and suck it dry long ago. Even the skin is used to make lanterns!"
"Indeed, it looks like that little kid has indeed been deceived."
There was an old woman who couldn't stand it and tried to persuade Xuan Ji.
"Little baby, don't listen to outsiders' slander. Go home with your parents as soon as possible.
From now on, you can no longer steal things from home. This is just eating inside and outside. It is not easy for your parents to support you! "
As he spoke, he looked at the lotus flowers with disdain, thinking that these two people looked human-like, but they were completely indifferent.
More and more people are leaning toward Zhou Ziheng's family, and they are all trying to persuade Xuan Ji to go home and be more obedient and not steal things from home.
But Lianhua Hehua was so angry that she didn't know how to refute.
They were also warned by their superiors not to hurt others at will and expose their identity. They felt very aggrieved.
Taohua and Hehua have never seen such a shameless person in the devil world.
There is no way to prove that what they say is correct, because those people don't believe it at all, they only believe what they believe.
Xuan Ji spoke at this time.
"You said I stole your spiritual plant, what was it?
You can't have something missing from your home and not know it, right? "
Xuan Ji's brain was not as easy to deceive as before. He could tell at a glance that this family was just interested in the spiritual plant in his hand.
Last time in that clothing store, the shameless Zhou Ziheng denied that he had been abandoned to evil cultivators because of that dog-tailed grass.
Now do this again?
title_en: Chapter 17: The Strange Oath of Heaven Chapter 18: Do you believe me when I say I didn’t do it?
